audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows 'Skill' for First item and 2+ items while the content layer and the packet both say Sylas.
audit.why: Content whys and the 56.13% win rate over 4062 games support Sylas from first item on; the two layers must agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Many fields misgender Mel as he/his; dosFull[1] title references a 'post-combo silence' Mel does not have; cooldowns field has no numbers; trade strings are the lane-wide template.
audit.why: Mel is she/her (MC_IS_FEMALE); her defining cooldown is Rebuttal at 38/35/33/29/26s; her E Solar Snare roots; her passive Overwhelm executes at a threshold and her ability casts load an auto reset volley.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed everywhere lint flagged; cooldowns field now carries 38s/26s and the 11-9s E cycle; trade strings grounded in Rebuttal-bait and Solar Snare; execute threshold and reflect stated.

audit.why: Mel W carries a 'terrain' derived flag but Riot's text describes a self barrier that reflects projectiles — no terrain is created. Flag misfire; not written into the page.
